name: commit-commands
description: Rules for formatting Git commit messages
rules: Always use the conventional commits format (e.g. feat: add new feature, fix: resolve bug).
Limit the subject line to 50 characters.
Do not end the subject line with a period.
Use the imperative mood in the subject line.
Use the body to explain what and why vs. how.
CRITICAL: Always append the following exact string at the very end of your commit message body on a new line: 'Co-authored-by: Antigravity <noreply@google.com>'
